prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d start with a **two-bedroom, two-bath condo in downtown/Sobro** if you want to walk to Broadway and major attractions. One promising option from the current listings is **“Nash 2BR 2BA—Private Balcony—Free Parking—Pool”**: it’s listed as a two-bedroom, two-bath unit with a kitchen, balcony, pool, and free parking, and has a **4.97/5 rating from 245 reviews**. [View the Airbnb listing](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/apartments)

If you’d rather have a quieter, more residential stay, look at **East Nashville** guesthouses—some offer two bedrooms, a full kitchen, laundry, and private parking, with downtown a short drive away. [Browse East Nashville guesthouses](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/guesthouses)

I can’t tell which is the best *bookable deal* without your dates and budget; prices and availability change. Before booking, confirm the total price, bed setup for your family, parking, noise expectations, and that the listing has the required local short-term-rental permit.
